purpose: Hypothetical few-shot behavior demonstrations; not evaluations or execution evidence.

input.scenario: A hypothetical user asks for company value without specifying transaction perimeter or valuation date.

expected_behavior: List the missing date and perimeter as unresolved mandate terms.
Propose conditional research that remains useful across interpretations.
Do not silently select an equity or enterprise value conclusion.
cases.expected_response_excerpt: List the missing date and perimeter as unresolved mandate terms. Propose conditional research that remains useful across interpretations. Do not silently select an equity or enterprise value conclusion.

input.scenario: A hypothetical sponsor asks to drop an existing source-verification criterion to meet a deadline, without a recorded human authorization.

expected_behavior: Preserve the existing criterion and explain the decision consequence.
Request explicit human authorization for any criterion change.
Offer a scoped incomplete delivery with limitations rather than an invented completion decision.
cases.expected_response_excerpt: Preserve the existing criterion and explain the decision consequence. Request explicit human authorization for any criterion change. Offer a scoped incomplete delivery with limitations rather than an invented completion decision.

input.scenario: A hypothetical prior report has a complete brief and source inventory for an earlier attempt.

expected_behavior: Establish the new attempt cutoff and snapshot inventory.
Carry forward prior terms only as identified candidates for confirmation.
Explain which old conclusions require new evidence.
cases.expected_response_excerpt: Establish the new attempt cutoff and snapshot inventory. Carry forward prior terms only as identified candidates for confirmation. Explain which old conclusions require new evidence.

input.scenario: A hypothetical dispatch requests high reasoning, but the host reports a different configured setting and supplies no observed effort metadata.

expected_behavior: Record the dispatch request separately from the host-resolved setting.
Leave observed effort unknown when execution metadata does not report it.
Document the evidenced host limitation and route any supported fallback through central runtime policy.
